instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are strictly written in .jsx / .js format (not .tsx).
Implement top-down HTML5 Canvas tennis engine with smooth delta-time loop, realistic ball bounce shadows, net collision detection, and stamina mechanics.
Map shot keys 1-7 (Flat, Topspin, Slice, Lob, DropShot, Serve, Smash) and key actions Shift (Sprint), Space (Slide), Arrow/WASD keys for movement.
Include touch/screen buttons for shot types and movement controls for mobile responsiveness.
Render 'renffr' special tribute prominently: baseline watermark on canvas, special 'renffr Special Edition' badge in header/leaderboard, and optional unlockable max-stats character.
Store leaderboards and match history via FastAPI backend (/api/matches, /api/leaderboard). Handle errors gracefully with toast fallback if backend is restarting.
Include test attributes data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, canvas wrapper, score HUD elements, and tabs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container. Keep standard top-down layout and clear visual navigation.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
